experiment_name: LoRA Router vs Vector Search - Sequence Classification Approach
improvements_made: Fixed chunk ID collision (lecture-based counter reset)
Improved topic extraction with proper noun weighting (+15 bonus)
Changed from Causal LM to Sequence Classification
Added gradient clipping and stability fixes
Changed train/test split from lecture-level to sample-level
Rebuilt FAISS index to match new chunk IDs

lora_advantages: 34.21% Top-1 accuracy vs 4.23% for Vector (8x better)
Average only 1.11 chunks returned (vs 5.0 for Vector)
Can reject irrelevant queries with NOT_RELEVANT
Better semantic understanding on fuzzy queries
remaining_challenges: NOT_RELEVANT detection at 0% (needs better negative samples)
Topic extraction still imperfect (some generic words)
Low confidence on abstract philosophical queries
Training data biased toward specific lecture topics
